sentences.text: At the very outset, learned A.G.A. submits that the plea of juvinility raised by applicant before Court below was wholly misconceived, inasmuch as no documentary evidence was filed by applicant before court below in support of same.

The evidence relied upon by applicant in support of his claim i.e.
application dated 3.10.1999 was wholly unworthy of reliance.
As such no illegality has been committed by court below in passing the impugned order.
Therefore, no intereference is warranted by this Court.
When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.
In view of above, the application fails and is liable to be rejected.
